top_signals.title: America’s Hydrogen Revolution Stalls Amid Funding Cuts and Weak Demand
top_signals.summary: Just a few years ago, the United States was developing new hydrogen hubs to support energy diversification and help achieve a green transition. However, the development of these fuel hubs has not proceeded as expected, with several major projects stalling and political support faltering. The Biden administration showed broad support for hydrogen production, aiming to massively expand the sector and advance green hydrogen development.
